adminconsult.title: View a pair
adminconsult.heading: View a pair
adminconsult.intro: Pick a single person to see who they give to. There is no full table of pairs.
adminconsult.warning: Every lookup is recorded in the log that every participant can see.
adminconsult.person.label: Person
adminconsult.password.label: Admin password
adminconsult.password.help: Type your admin password again for every lookup.
adminconsult.no_mail: Nobody gets an email: only the group log keeps the date.
adminconsult.result.heading: Pair viewed
adminconsult.result.no_target: This person only receives: they give no gift.
adminconsult.result.logged: This lookup has just been recorded in the group log, without any name.
adminconsult.error.person: Pick a person from the group.
adminconsult.error.no_draw: The draw has not happened yet: there is no pair to view.
adminconsult.error.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
adminconsult.error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again later.
adminconsult.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
adminconsult.error.invalid: The request could not be read. Try again.
adminconsult.journal.title: Pair lookup log
adminconsult.journal.heading: Group log
adminconsult.journal.entry: The organiser viewed a pair. Nobody else was told.
adminconsult.journal.empty: The organiser has not viewed any pair.
